standard_prerequisites.name: The statement that a closed subset of a quasi-compact space is quasi-compact
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 2968-2970)
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives quasi-compactness of the closed piece inside a quasi-compact open.

core_obligations: Decompose the constructible subset into finitely many differences of retrocompact opens (proof lines 2961-2964)
Reduce to one piece: it suffices to see that the intersection of such a difference with an arbitrary quasi-compact open is quasi-compact (proof lines 2964-2966)

Apply quasi-compactness: that intersection is closed in the quasi-compact set obtained by intersecting the two open members, so it is quasi-compact, which is exactly retrocompactness (proof lines 2966-2970)
proof_roadmap: 把可构造 E 写成有限个 U_i ∩ V_i^c（U_i、V_i retrocompact 开）之并。
对任意准紧开 W，E ∩ W = ∪ (U_i ∩ V_i^c ∩ W)，只需证单项 U ∩ V^c ∩ W 准紧。
U ∩ V^c ∩ W 是准紧集 U ∩ W 中的闭子集 ⇒ 准紧（closed-in-quasi-compact 引理）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that in a space where quasi-compact opens form a basis, every constructible subset is retrocompact (author lemma at source lines 2949-2959, label lemma-constructible-is-retrocompact). The proof (source lines 2961-2971) decomposes the subset into finitely many differences of retrocompact opens, reduces to a single piece and uses that the piece is closed inside a quasi-compact open (proof lines 2961-2970). The reduction to one piece is the content. H3.
